controversy_hook.primary_harm_thesis: perpetual procurement escalation and domestic surveillance expansion over local infrastructure

vote.question: [US-MI - U.S. Senate]: Abdul El-sayed (D) has received $53,830,872 in career campaign contributions (with $53,830,872 this cycle, alongside $95,105,219 in outside Super PAC support led by WinSenate)—linked to "Defense, Aerospace & Surveillance Contractor Bloc". Do you vote to formally rebuke Abdul El-sayed for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Abdul El-sayed has amassed $53,830,872 in career contributions (with $53,830,872 this cycle, alongside $95,105,219 in outside Super PAC support led by WinSenate)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Abdul El-sayed on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.
outcomes.NO_RELEASE_TO_COMMUNITY_COMMONS: Directs 100% of the funds to bipartisan, universal local public services (volunteer fire/EMS, veterans' care, food banks, disaster relief).
outcomes.ABSTAIN_LOG_DISSENT: Records resident feedback without moving the vote count.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $5,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-MI: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving MI dedicated to veterans' trauma/housing rehabilitation and digital privacy civil-liberties defense. Verified local recipients: LAKESHORE LEGAL AID (US-EIN:381850908); WAYNE COUNTY NEIGHBORHOOD LEGAL SERVICES (US-EIN:381818068); ASSURED FAMILY SERVICES (US-EIN:760709231); LEGAL AID OF WESTERN MICHIGAN (US-EIN:382156874); SPECTRUM JUVENILE JUSTICE SERVICES (US-EIN:383215802). Once the pool hits $5,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-MI with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: LAKESHORE LEGAL AID (US-EIN:381850908); WAYNE COUNTY NEIGHBORHOOD LEGAL SERVICES (US-EIN:381818068); ASSURED FAMILY SERVICES (US-EIN:760709231); LEGAL AID OF WESTERN MICHIGAN (US-EIN:382156874); SPECTRUM JUVENILE JUSTICE SERVICES (US-EIN:383215802).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $5,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $5,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).

bounty_if_no_wins.description: Community Commons for US-MI: If residents decide against the restitution fund, 100% of the funds go directly to essential local community services in US-MI (Volunteer Fire/EMS, Veterans' Care, Food Banks, and Disaster Relief). Recipient non-profits: HURON VALLEY AMBULANCE INC (US-EIN:382200909); FOODBANK COUNCIL OF MICHIGAN INC (US-EIN:382515765); COREWELL HEALTH (US-EIN:611740292); HENRY FORD HEALTH SYSTEM (US-EIN:381357020); TRINITY HEALTH-MICHIGAN (US-EIN:382113393).
